# ui::OptionalFloat

Header: `winui/core/OptionalFloat.hpp`.

A float that may be unset: the type of every optional size, length and value in an option field or setter. Any number fills it (`.min_item_width = 120`, `set_width(240)`), `std::nullopt` or `{}` leaves it unset, and it converts to and from `std::optional<float>`. Reading it works as on an optional: test it, then dereference it or call [value_or()](#value_or).

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::TileLayout tiles{ .min_item_width = 120, .min_item_height = 90 };

auto panel = std::make_unique<ui::TilePanelControl>();
panel->set_item_width(std::nullopt); // back to the first item's width
```
